commitResults.messageBody:
Rename the seedu.address package to seedu.tutorlink, AddressBook to
TutorLink and Person to Student across main code, tests and test data,
so the codebase matches the product domain before feature work starts.

Behaviour is unchanged. The phone, email, address and tag fields are
kept for now and will be replaced by the MVP fields in later PRs.

commitResults.messageTitle: Match student names ignoring case and spacing
commitResults.messageBody:
Treat names that differ only in letter case or whitespace as the same
student, so that adding 'john tan' when 'John Tan' exists is rejected as
a duplicate. Real-world names are not case-sensitive, and the PE bug
guidelines treat case-sensitive duplicate detection as a feature flaw.

Add Name#isSameName and use it in Student#isSameStudent.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add Subject class and subject parsing
commitResults.messageBody:
Add a Subject value class for the s/SUBJECT parameter of 'student add'
(F1), with the validation rules from the Week 6 feature spec: 1 to 30
characters from letters, digits, spaces, hyphens, '+' and '&'.

Add ParserUtil#parseSubject and #parseSubjects. Subjects keep the order
they were given in, and the same subject given twice (ignoring case)
is rejected. Subjects are not yet stored in Student; a later PR will
replace tags with subjects.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add student lookup by name to Model
commitResults.messageBody:
Add Model#findStudentByName, which returns the student whose name
matches the given name ignoring case and extra whitespace.

'student view n/NAME' (F2) will use it, and so can any other command
that takes n/NAME, so that every command looks students up the same
way and shows the same not-found error.

commitResults.messageTitle: Support two-word command words such as student add
commitResults.messageBody:
Let the parser read a command word made of a domain and an action
(student, interaction or followup, followed by the action), as agreed
in the team's command naming rule. Command words are now matched
ignoring case and extra spaces.

Change the add command's word from 'add' to 'student add' (F1). The
other AB3 commands keep their one-word command words for now.
